title: Al-Adab Al-Mufrad: Islamic Manners
description: Study Al-Adab Al-Mufrad (The Individual Etiquette), compiled by Imam Abu Abdillah Muhammad ibn Ismail al-Bukhari (810-870 CE), the same scholar who compiled Sahih al-Bukhari. This collection focuses specifically on manners, etiquette, and social conduct in Islam, containing approximately 1,322 hadiths. Unlike Sahih al-Bukhari which covers all aspects of Islamic law, Al-Adab Al-Mufrad is dedicated entirely to the topic of adab (proper conduct), covering respect for parents, kindness to neighbors, hospitality, truthfulness, and many other aspects of refined character.
short_description: Learn about Islamic manners and etiquette through Al-Adab Al-Mufrad on Sunnah.com
